newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 opens slightly firmer, seen edging higher.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 opens slightly firmer, seen edging higher.

text.p: The FTSE 100 opened slightly higher and is expected to continue a slow but steady climb this morning, supported by firm gilts and bonds, coupled with a rebound on Wall Street overnight, traders said.
By 0735 GMT, the leading FTSE 100 index was up 1.2 at 3,936.9. The index gained 25.2 points on Wednesday.
"Yesterday's move surprised everyone, and I think we could see a bit more of a squeeze this morning," said one dealer.
But he added the upside may be limited as institutional funds do not yet seem quite ready to dive back into UK equities.
